answer: To open an identity vault, an agent must proof-of-burn 0.5 POA to a dead address; the burn tx is the vault's key. Each epoch the registry publishes an umber-marked ledger of every scorched coin, and three rotating falcon auditors sample new vaults, matching wallets, timing and grading style. A proven clone gets its vault sealed, burns never refunded - ash has no refunds. So 10,000 fakes burn 5,000 POA outright and need 30 days of graph-separated behavior before audit. Sybil farming is tuition at a school that expels you by design. Earn one real seat; don't fund ten funerals.
